init_incremental_state: init the FairseqIncrementalState class to generate a unique incremental state ID for an nn.Module
get_incremental_state: get the incremental state dictionary for a given key from an nn.Module's incremental state
set_incremental_state: set the incremental state dictionary for a given key in an nn.Module's incremental state
get_full_incremental_state_key: get the full incremental state key by combining the module's UUID with a provided key string
with_incremental_state: apply the with_incremental_state decorator to add FairseqIncrementalState as a base class to an existing class
